scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items! -
scripts.translation: - 您攜帶的物品太多了！ -

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Hmmm...
I can feel a strange force growing stronger and stronger, somewhere in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
嗯...
我感覺到米德加爾特某處有一股奇怪的力量正在不斷增強。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Can you feel it?
Something must be
going on!
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
你能感覺到嗎？
一定有什麼事要發生了！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'm waiting for the day when I'll finally get to see Thor's thunder for myself. I believe that one of these days, my dream will become reality.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我一直在等待能親眼看到托爾雷霆的那一天。我相信總有一天，我的夢想會成真。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You came back!
In exchange for the ores that you have brought me, I will give you one of my family treasures.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
你回來了！
作為對你帶來礦石的回報，我會送你一件家傳寶物。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You have two options in choosing a treasure. You can have a treasure that will be useful to yourself, or something that may suit one of your friends.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
選擇寶物時有兩個選項。你可以選擇一件對自己有用的寶物，或者一件可能適合你朋友的寶物。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
So which treasure
would you like to have?
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
那麼，你想選擇哪件寶物呢？

scripts.text: An item that I can use.
scripts.translation: 一件我能用的物品

scripts.text: An item that my friend can use.
scripts.translation: 一件我朋友能用的物品

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I see...
Give me a moment
to find a suitable
item for you.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
明白了...
請稍等，我去找一件適合你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I see...
Give me a moment
to find a suitable
item for your friend.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
明白了...
請稍等，我去找一件適合你朋友的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Okay, let's see...
I seem to recall that I put it somewhere around... Hmm.
It must be around--Ah!
Here we are~
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
好的，讓我看看...
我記得我把它放在...嗯。
應該是在這裡——啊！
找到了~

scripts.text: Unknown error occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Once again, I thank you for the trouble you've gone through on my behalf. I'm unsure of how this works, but I hope it will be useful to you. From what I know, I believe this is a rare item.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
再次感謝你不辭辛勞為我辦事。我不太清楚這東西的用法，但希望它能對你有用。據我所知，這應該是一件稀有物品。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'll be waiting for the day when I'll see Thor's thunder for myself. I believe that the dream I've had will come true, one of these days.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我會繼續等待親眼看到托爾雷霆的那一天。我相信我懷有的夢想，總有一天會成真。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I need
50 Rough Oridecon
and 50 Rough Elunium.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我需要50個神之金屬原石和50個鋁原石。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I don't have much time, so go ahead and continue on your journeys if you can't bring those to me.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我時間不多，如果你無法把這些帶給我，就請繼續你的旅程吧。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I sense a strange energy growing more powerful somewhere on this continent...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我感覺到這片大陸的某處有一股奇怪的能量正在變得更強...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Can you feel it?
Something must be going on!
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
你能感覺到嗎？
一定有什麼事要發生了！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I think we'd better wait and see what's happening. Someone will deliver the news to us. Though, I am unsure of whether or not it will be good news or bad...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我想我們最好先觀望一下局勢。會有人把訊息帶給我們的。不過，我不確定那會是好訊息還是壞訊息...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You've met the four Dwarven Blacksmiths. I've heard that they rarely speak to humans. So you must be special if you were able to talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
你見過四位矮人鐵匠。我聽說他們很少與人類對話。既然你能和他們說話，你一定很特別。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Do you think that my dream will come true? Do you believe Thor's Mjolnir will appear before the eyes of humans? I'm afraid great change will come to this world.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
你認為我的夢想會實現嗎？你相信雷神之錘會出現在人類眼前嗎？我恐怕這個世界將迎來巨大的變革。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Thank you for going through such trouble on my behalf. I wish to give you one of my family treasures as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
謝謝你為我費心。我想送你一件家傳寶物，以表謝意。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
However, I hope you understand that my family would grow suspicious if one of the treasures were to just go missing.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
不過，希望你能理解，如果一件寶物突然失蹤，我的家人肯定會起疑心。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Hmm, however, I don't think they'll complain if I exchanged one of the treasures for something else. Let me think...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
嗯，不過如果他們知道我是用一件寶物換了別的東西，應該就不會抱怨了。讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I should be able to give you
one of our family heirlooms if you can bring be 50 Rough Oridecons and 50 Rough Eluniums.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
如果你能給我50個神之金屬原石和50個鋁原石，我就可以送你一件家傳寶物。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You don't have to do that if you don't want to. But it seems our family heirlooms would be more useful to an adventurer such as yourself...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
如果你不願意，也可以不做。但看來這些家傳寶物對你這樣的冒險者更有用...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Hmm...
The Dwarven Blacksmiths
must be upset at you for
some reason.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
嗯...
矮人鐵匠們一定因為某件事對你很不滿。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Remember my sister's
suggestion and speak to
them with great courtesy.
Carefully choose words
of respect lest they
be insulted.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
記住我姐姐的建議，對他們要非常客氣。
謹慎選擇尊重的措辭，以免冒犯他們。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You should be okay now.
By this time, they've probably forgotten the insult. But make sure you speak to my sister for advice first.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
現在應該沒問題了。
到這個時候，他們大概已經忘了那件事。但記得先去找我姐姐問問建議。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Sorry for the trouble.
I wish you good luck
in finding the Dwarves!
Just... Don't insult them!
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
抱歉給你添麻煩了。
祝你在尋找矮人時好運！
只是...千萬別冒犯他們！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I sense a strange energy growing more powerful somewhere on this continent...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我感覺到這片大陸的某處有一股奇怪的能量正在變得更強...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Can you feel it?
Something must be going on!
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
你能感覺到嗎？
一定有什麼事要發生了！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I think we'd better wait and see what's happening. Someone will deliver the news to us. Though, I am unsure of whether or not it will be good news or bad...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我想我們最好先觀望一下局勢。會有人把訊息帶給我們的。不過，我不確定那會是好訊息還是壞訊息...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
One of my ancestors supposedly was a servant of Thor. Still, I find it difficult to believe.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
據說我的祖先之一是托爾的神僕。不過，我很難相信這一點。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
If the gods have all these powers, how could a mere human be of any real assistance?
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
如果眾神擁有如此強大的力量，區區人類又能幫上什麼忙呢？

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Last night, I had the most amazing dream where I was the servant of Thor, god of thunder.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
昨晚，我做了一個不可思議的夢，夢裡我是雷神托爾的僕人。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
In this dream, I traveled
with Thor to Jotunnheim, land of giants. During our journey, he told me many interesting stories about gods and heroes.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
在夢中，我跟隨托爾前往巨人國度約頓海姆。旅途中，他給我講了許多關於眾神和英雄的有趣故事。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Of course, I can't remember everything clearly, but it was truly fantastic.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
當然，我記不清所有細節，但那真的非常精彩。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
For some reason, I can vividly recall what Thor told me about his weapon, Mjolnir. Mjolnir is a Dwarven masterpiece.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
不知為何，我清晰地記得托爾告訴我關於他的武器雷神之錘的事。雷神之錘是矮人的傑作。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Thor told me that Dwarves are extremely talented artisans, and their works are supreme. So as
I was thinking about my dream,
I remembered...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
托爾告訴我，矮人是極具天賦的工匠，他們的作品登峰造極。所以當我回想這個夢時，我想起了...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
There is a mountain that
has the same name as Thor's
weapon. Surely, the two have
some relation to each other.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
有一座山與托爾的武器同名。這兩者之間肯定有某種聯絡。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I've also recently heard a rumor that Dwarven Blacksmiths also reside on Mount Mjolnir.
I understand the mountain is dangerous, and that I'm in no position to ask such a thing...
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
最近我還聽到一個傳聞，說矮人鐵匠也住在雷神之錘山上。
我知道那座山很危險，我也知道我不該提出這樣的要求...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I can't help wanting to know for myself whether or not there is truth to my dream. Is it possible for Mjolnir to resurface?
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我忍不住想知道我的夢是否屬實。雷神之錘有可能重新現世嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
If you don't mind, I'd like to ask you to explore this mountain and search for these Dwarven Blacksmiths.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
如果不介意的話，我想請你探索這座山，尋找這些矮人鐵匠。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I see. But I still appreciate that you took the time to listen to me.
Hopefully someday I'll learn the truth about my dreams and about Mjolnir itself.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我明白了。但我還是很感激你願意花時間聽我傾訴。
希望有一天我能弄清我夢境的真相，以及雷神之錘本身的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Thank you,
thank you so much!
Even though it won't be easy, I have faith that if the Dwarven Blacksmiths do exist, you'll be able to find them.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
謝謝你，真的非常感謝！
雖然這不會容易，但我相信，如果矮人鐵匠真的存在，你一定能找到他們。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Oh, and please speak to my sister Roskva first. She is outside the North Entrance of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
哦，對了，請先去和我姐姐羅絲克瓦對話。她在普隆德拉北門外面。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'm sure that she can
give you useful information if you're fortunate enough to encounter the Dwarves.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我相信，如果你有幸遇到矮人，她一定能給你提供有用的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'm truly lucky to meet such an adventurer like yourself. I wish you the best of luck.
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
能遇到像你這樣的冒險者，我真的很幸運。祝你一路順風。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I believe in you.
Just be courageous!
scripts.translation:
[提亞爾菲]
我相信你。
只要勇敢一點就好！

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
You should know that Dwarven Blacksmiths are extremely offended if you do not speak to them with the utmost respect.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
你應該知道，如果你不以最尊重的態度與矮人鐵匠對話，他們會非常生氣。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
So it's really
important that you
speak to the Dwarves
as courteously as you can.
The first Dwarf you must visit
can be found to the East.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
所以，儘可能禮貌地與矮人對話非常重要。
你要拜訪的第一位矮人在東方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
Travel in a clock wise direction around Midgard and seek out the other Dwarves in order. Your final destination will be to the North.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
請沿順時針方向繞米德加爾特行進，按順序尋找其他矮人。你的最終目的地在北方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
If you happen to speak to them in the wrong order, please go talk to my brother Tialfi again.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
如果你不小心按錯誤的順序與他們對話了，請再去和我哥哥提亞爾菲談談。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
You should know that Dwarven Blacksmiths are extremely offended if you do not speak to them with the utmost respect.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
你應該知道，如果你不以最尊重的態度與矮人鐵匠對話，他們會非常生氣。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
So it's really
important that you
speak to the Dwarves
as courteously as you can.
The first Dwarf you must visit
can be found to the North.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
所以，儘可能禮貌地與矮人對話非常重要。
你要拜訪的第一位矮人在北方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
Travel in a counter clock wise direction around Midgard and seek out the other Dwarves in order. Your final destination will be to the East.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
請沿逆時針方向繞米德加爾特行進，按順序尋找其他矮人。你的最終目的地在東方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
If you happen to speak to them in the wrong order, please go talk to my brother Tialfi again.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
如果你不小心按錯誤的順序與他們對話了，請再去和我哥哥提亞爾菲談談。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
A long time ago, many people used to frequent this area. Friends and families would live here, sharing happiness and sadness.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
很久以前，很多人常來這片區域。朋友和家人住在這裡，分享著快樂與悲傷。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
But they're all gone now. My parents and my friends have all gone to a place whose name I don't even know.
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
但現在他們都走了。我的父母和朋友們都去了一個我甚至不知道名字的地方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
I can't help
but feel lonesome...
scripts.translation:
[羅絲克瓦]
我忍不住感到孤獨...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Something is happening somewhere on this continent. You might not believe me, but I keep getting visions of the Fenrir-Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
這片大陸的某處正在發生著什麼。你可能不信，但我不斷看到芬里爾之狼的幻象。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Something is happening somewhere on this continent. You might not believe me, but I keep getting visions of the Fenrir-Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
這片大陸的某處正在發生著什麼。你可能不信，但我不斷看到芬里爾之狼的幻象。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
When my people finally retrieve the memories of their past, we will be able to grant the power of the gods to humans.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
當我的族人最終找回過去的記憶時，我們將能夠賦予人類神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
I believe that
time is coming...
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
我相信那個時刻就要到了...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Hm? I sense that you were asked to do a favor for that human. If I were you, I'd finish that task as soon as I could. Somehow, that human's fate, as well as that of the Dwarves, are intertwined...
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
嗯？我感覺到你被要求幫那個人類一個忙。如果我是你，我會盡快完成那個任務。不知為何，那個人類的命運，以及矮人的命運，都交織在一起了...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What is it?! I refuse to speak to human as rude and contemptible
as you! Now, get out of my sight!
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
什麼？！我拒絕與像你這樣粗魯且令人厭惡的人類對話！現在，給我滾出我的視線！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What...?
I have nothing
to say to you.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
什麼...？
我沒什麼想對你說的。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Hm...?
Why have you
come to me, human?
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
嗯...？
你為何來找我，人類？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Hey, 'sup!
scripts.translation: 嘿，你好啊！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
...
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What...?!
Do not greet the
Dwarves lightly,
mortal!
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
什麼？！
凡人，不可如此輕慢地向矮人致意！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What has made
you come to me?
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
是什麼事讓你來找我？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打擾了，先生

scripts.text:
[Austri]
...
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Ah, I see that the entire human race is not worthy of scorn. Unlike many of your kind, I see that you respect your elders.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
啊，看來並非所有人類都令人鄙夷。與你們中的許多人不同，我看到你懂得尊敬長者。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
So what did
want to ask
me about?
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
那麼你想問我什麼？

scripts.text: About Mjolnir.
scripts.translation: 關於雷神之錘

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Mjolnir...?
Thor's legendary weapon?
The hammer than can shake the earth and tear the sky asunder? Out of all of legendary weapons, Mjolnir is perhaps greatest.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
雷神之錘...？
托爾的傳奇武器？
那把能撼動大地、撕裂天空的錘子？在所有傳奇武器中，雷神之錘或許是最偉大的。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
As a matter of fact, it was forged by my ancestor. Mjolnir was the perfect weapon, except for one minor flaw.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
事實上，它是由我的祖先鍛造的。雷神之錘是完美的武器，除了一個小瑕疵。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
The hilt of Mjolnir was forged shorter than intended. Are you still listening to me?
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
雷神之錘的柄比預想的要短。你還在聽嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，長官！

scripts.text: Huh?
scripts.translation: 咦？

scripts.text:
[Austri]
One day, Loki came to our village and showed off his treasures. He boasted that we couldn't possibly create something to surpass their quality.

好吧，我會跟我的兄弟們說你的好話。
希望他們能給你提供幫助。

be safe on
your travels!

那麼，旅途平安！

you here, human?

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Huh. You're different than other humans. But still, trusting you because you know how to speak respectfully isn't very wise.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
哼。你和其他人類不太一樣。
不過，僅僅因為你懂禮貌就信任你，這可不是什麼明智之舉。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
If there's anything I love,
it's bare knuckle brawling,
old school style.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
如果要說我最熱愛什麼，那就是赤手空拳的格鬥，最原始的那種風格。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Words can be deceptive,
but if you can beat me in
a fight, I think I might
just talk to you.
How about it?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
言語可能會欺騙人，但如果你能在戰鬥中打敗我，我想我或許會願意和你聊聊。
怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Yes, I accept your challenge.

scripts.text: No, I'm scared!

[Sudri]

even answer me!
Fine! Whatever!

[蘇德里]
你甚至都沒回答我！
算了！隨你便！

[Sudri]

啊，我已經開始喜歡你了，人類！
現在，你不妨去熱熱身，等你準備好了我們再打。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Eh...?
Why are you being
such a coward?
Are you afraid of
this old and tiny Dwarf?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
呃...？
你為什麼這麼膽小？
你是怕我這個又老又小的矮人嗎？

scripts.translation: 蘇德里獲勝！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Muhahahaha!
You're not strong enough to beat me! I want someone who can offer
me a challenge!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
穆哈哈哈！
你還不夠強，打不過我！
我想要一個能給我帶來挑戰的對手！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Go out, train some and get stronger before you even think about coming back!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
出去練練，變強了再來找我吧！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You're stronger than me. I never thought I'd meet a human as strong as you.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
你比我強。
我沒想到會遇到像你這麼強的人類。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
I'm impressed! Alright, I'll tell my friends good things about you. Hopefully, my brothers will give you the help you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
我很佩服你！
好吧，我會跟我的兄弟們說你的好話。
希望他們能給你提供幫助。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Okay then,
be safe on
your travels!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
那麼，旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
What made you come to me?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
是什麼讓你來找我的？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打擾了，先生

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You have too much
time on your hands.
Why don't you log out and go out with your friends instead?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
你閒得發慌了。
不如下線去跟你的朋友們聚聚？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Huh. You're different than other humans. But still, trusting you because you know how to speak respectfully isn't very wise.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
哼。你和其他人類不太一樣。
不過，僅僅因為你懂禮貌就信任你，這可不是什麼明智之舉。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
If there's anything I love,
it's bare knuckle brawling,
old school style.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
如果要說我最熱愛什麼，那就是赤手空拳的格鬥，最原始的那種風格。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Words can be deceptive,
but if you can beat me in
a fight, I think I might
just talk to you.
How about it?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
言語可能會欺騙人，但如果你能在戰鬥中打敗我，我想我或許會願意和你聊聊。
怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Yes, I accept your challenge.
scripts.translation: 是的，我接受你的挑戰

scripts.text: No, I'm scared!
scripts.translation: 不，我害怕了！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You didn't
even answer me!
Fine! Whatever!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
你甚至都沒回答我！
算了！隨你便！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Ah, I like you already, human! Now why don't you go do some warm ups, and we'll fight when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
啊，我已經開始喜歡你了，人類！
現在，你不妨去熱熱身，等你準備好了我們再打。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Eh...?
Why are you being
such a coward?
Are you afraid of
this old and tiny Dwarf?
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
呃...？
你為什麼這麼膽小？
你是怕我這個又老又小的矮人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Come on, I'll even let you have the first hit. Just come to me when you're ready to fight!
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
來吧，我甚至會讓你先出手。
等你準備好戰鬥了就來找我！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Zzzz Zzzz...

[Sudri]
In a one on one fight, you put everything on the line to show your might to your opponent.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
在單挑中，你會押上所有籌碼，向對手展示你的力量。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Have you ever felt the same way I do, human? Win or lose, just giving your all is the most satisfying accomplishment.
scripts.translation:
[蘇德里]
人類，你是否有過和我一樣的感受？
無論勝負，全力以赴本身就是最滿足的成就。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Zzzz Zzzz...

[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
如果你想要什麼，就應該靠自己的努力去爭取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
不管別人怎麼說，只要你自信且意志堅定，你總會對自己的結果感到滿意。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you think?
Kids these days...
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
你覺得呢？
現在的年輕人啊...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I don't feel
like doing anything
today. Anything at all...
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
我今天什麼都不想做。
什麼都...不想做...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Someone must have forged something really monstrous, otherwise I wouldn't be feeling so worthless!
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
一定是有人鍛造出了什麼怪物級的東西，不然我怎麼會覺得自己這麼沒用！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Yeah, I think I need a break! Don't you think I need a break, human?
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
是啊，我覺得我需要休息一下！
你不覺得我也該休息一下嗎，人類？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
There's nothing like taking a relaxing break after putting your heart into your work.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
全心投入工作後，沒有什麼比放鬆休息更愜意的了。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you think,
human? Isn't that one
of life's simple pleasures?
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
你覺得呢，人類？
這不是生活中簡單的樂趣之一嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
如果你想要什麼，就應該靠自己的努力去爭取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
不管別人怎麼說，只要你自信且意志堅定，你總會對自己的結果感到滿意。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you think?
Kids these days...
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
你覺得呢？
現在的年輕人啊...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I really hope I meet a decent human being next time. So far, I haven't met one useful human.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
真希望下次能遇到個靠譜的人類。
到目前為止，我還沒遇到過有用的人類。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Perfect preparation does not always result in success. There's a point when you've got to just go out and do it.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
完美的準備並不總能帶來成功。
到了某個時刻，你就必須放手一搏。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I don't know how
big your goals are,
but put your heart into
whatever it is that you
plan to accomplish in life.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
我不知道你的目標有多大，但請全心投入你計劃在生活中實現的任何事。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
你想要什麼？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
如果你想要什麼，就應該靠自己的努力去爭取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
不管別人怎麼說，只要你自信且意志堅定，你總會對自己的結果感到滿意。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
You didn't answer the question! Now, you've probably got the wrong Dwarf here...
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
你沒有回答問題！
現在，你大概找錯矮人了吧...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Get out of here, and go to your human Blacksmiths if you want equipment upgrades!
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
滾出去，如果你想升級裝備，去找你們人類的鐵匠！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Great...!
Which one should I upgrade first, huh? My heart is pounding with anticipation...
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
太好了！
我該先升級哪一個呢？
我的心因期待而怦怦直跳...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What...?!
This isn't upgradable!
What the hell do you want
me to do with this?
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
什麼...？！
這東西不能升級！
你到底想讓我拿它怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Oh, this is excellent! This piece here has been perfectly refined! But this isn't what I want. I can't do any work on this at all.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
哦，這很棒！這件作品已經完美精煉了！
但這不是我想要的。我完全無法對它進行任何加工。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
This item isn't even a challenge to upgrade. You can get humans to do this kind of beginner's stuff. Get them to refine it first.
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
這件物品甚至算不上升級的挑戰。
這種新手活兒你可以讓人類去做。讓他們先精煉一下。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Come on...
Bring me something
that presents an
element of risk!
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
拜託...
給我拿點有風險的東西來！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Armor?!
Didn't I tell
you that I only work
on Level 4 weapons?
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
防具？！
我不是說過我只加工4級武器嗎？

scripts.text:

This is a legend about one
of Thor's journeys into Utgard,
land of the giants.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
這是關於托爾前往巨人國度烏特加德的一段傳說。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There, he made a wager with their king in which he would challenge
the giants of their land in tests of skill and strength.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
在那裡，他與巨人的國王打賭，要挑戰那裡的巨人們，進行技藝和力量的較量。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]

scripts.translation:
[諾德里]

scripts.text:

actually a giant. Illusion was used to disguise Thor's opponent, but I forget was it was. Do you know?

scripts.translation: 貪婪

scripts.text: Sea
scripts.translation: 大海

scripts.text: Blaze
scripts.translation: 烈焰

scripts.text: Hog
scripts.translation: 野豬

scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
這一次，對手同樣是用幻術偽裝出來的。你知道提亞爾菲實際上在和誰賽跑嗎？

scripts.text: Language
scripts.translation: 語言

scripts.text: Thoughts
scripts.translation: 思想

scripts.text: Turtle
scripts.translation: 烏龜

scripts.text: Wolf
scripts.translation: 狼

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, right! Tialfi was racing 'thoughts!' Nothing can move faster than the speed of thought, so it's no wonder Tialfi would always lose.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
沒錯，對了！提亞爾菲是在和“思想”賽跑！沒有什麼能比思想的速度更快，所以提亞爾菲總是輸也就不足為奇了。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
For the final contest, Thor would challenge an old woman in a wrestling match. At first, Thor thought his victory was assured, but he learned that he could not defeat the old crone.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
最後一項比賽，托爾要與一位老婦人進行摔跤。起初，托爾以為勝券在握，但他發現根本無法擊敗這位老嫗。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Once again, Thor was the victim
of illusion magic. He didn't realize he wasn't actually wrestling with an old woman. Do you know what his opponent really was?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
這一次，托爾又中了幻術。他並沒有意識到自己實際上並不是在和一位老婦人摔跤。你知道他的對手真正是什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Curse
scripts.translation: 詛咒

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 大地

scripts.text: Heart
scripts.translation: 心

scripts.text: Old Age
scripts.translation: 衰老

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, Thor was wrestling with 'Old Age!' No matter how strong anybody is, you can't fight against aging.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
沒錯，托爾是在和“衰老”摔跤！無論一個人多麼強壯，都無法戰勝衰老。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
After Thor lost every match,
the king told him the truth about the contests. Thor grew furious, but it was too late. The king and the giants all vanished by then.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
托爾輸掉了所有比賽後，國王告訴他了比賽的真相。托爾勃然大怒，但為時已晚。國王和巨人們全都消失了。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There are two lessons
to be learned from this tale. First, don't believe everything you see. Second, never be overconfident of your own power.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
這個故事有兩個教訓。
第一，不要相信你所看到的一切。第二，永遠不要對自己的力量過於自信。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There will always be someone or something more powerful than you. It is important to always do your best and have an attitude of humility.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
總會有比你更強大的人或事物存在。保持謙遜的態度，並始終盡力而為，這一點很重要。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Try to live as good a life as you can. Remember that you can't have everything that you want. Obssession and irrationality go hand in hand.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
儘量過好的生活。記住，你不可能得到你想要的一切。執念和非理性總是相伴而生。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Thank you for listening to my long story. If you meet someone with a dangerous obsession, please tell this story of Thor and the illusions of the giant king.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
謝謝你聽我講這麼長的故事。如果你遇到有人陷入危險的執念，請告訴他托爾和巨人國王幻覺的故事。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh...?
I don't think that's right. Let me think, maybe I can remember it. Hopefully, it'll come to me sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
嗯...？
我覺得不對。讓我想想，也許我能想起來。希望我遲早能想起來...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Shall we talk more of this once again after enjoying another Red Potion? Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
我們再喝一杯紅色藥水，然後繼續聊這個話題吧？哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Oooh...
I'm sooo thirsty!
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
哦哦...
我渴死了！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Hm, didn't I ask you to bring a Red Potion? There's no way I can tell any stories with such a dry throat~
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
嗯，我不是讓你帶紅色藥水來嗎？嗓子這麼幹，我沒法講故事啊~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
你找我有什麼事，人類？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
If that's the case,
then leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
哼。
如果是那樣的話，就別來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Odd. Recently, too many humans have been interested in meeting with me and my brothers. Still, I cannot say their visits have been unpleasant.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
奇怪。最近有太多人類想見我和我的兄弟們了。不過，我也不能說他們的來訪不愉快。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
I'm a little thirsty. Would you bring me a Red Potion. If you do that for me, I will tell you an important story. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
我有點渴。你能給我帶一瓶紅色藥水嗎？如果你幫我這個忙，我會告訴你一個重要的故事。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Zzzz Zzzz...
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
呼嚕呼嚕...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Eh heh heh~
It's nice being in the Mjolnir Forest. To be surrounded by the quiet, peaceful air and not having to worry about anything...
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
嘿嘿嘿~
在雷神之錘森林待著真舒服。被寧靜祥和的空氣包圍，什麼都不用擔心...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Shouldn't you be on your way by now? Eh, it's none of my business.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
你不該早就出發了嗎？嗯，這也不是我的事。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
If you have the Zeny to spare, why don't you buy some snacks for your travels? Perhaps some delicious Bananas, or even some Pumpkins...
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
如果你有多餘的Zeny，為什麼不買點路上的零食呢？也許是一些美味的香蕉，甚至是南瓜...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
你找我有什麼事，人類？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
If that's the case,
then leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
哼。
如果是那樣的話，就別來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
That's fine. Still...
I'm surprised to see
such a polite human.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
哼。
那好吧。不過...
見到你這麼有禮貌的人類，我有點驚訝。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Ah, you've brought
me a Red Potion...?
In return, I will
tell you an old story.
I'm sure you'll like it.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
啊，你帶了紅色藥水來...？
作為回報，我會給你講一個古老的故事。
我相信你會喜歡的。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There is a story of a Dwarf named Alvis who contained more knowledge than a library and was braver than Siegfried the warrior.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
有一個名叫阿爾維斯的矮人的故事，他比圖書館還博學，比戰士齊格飛還勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Unfortunately...
He was too ambitious.
He fell in love with Thrud, Thor's first daughter, at first sight.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
不幸的是...
他太有野心了。
他一見托爾的大女兒特魯德就愛上了她。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
He asked Thor for permission to marry Thrud, but as was expected, Thor refused. Alvis should have given up there, but he didn't.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
他向托爾請求娶特魯德，但不出所料，托爾拒絕了。阿爾維斯本該就此放棄，但他沒有。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
So Thor decided to test his knowledge by asking him some questions. The first question was, 'What is the name of the ground in human terms?' Do you know the answer?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
於是托爾決定通過提問來測試他的知識。第一個問題是：“用人類的語言來說，大地的名字是什麼？”你知道答案嗎？

scripts.text: Ymir's body
scripts.translation: 尤彌爾的身體

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 大地

scripts.text: Lane
scripts.translation: 道路

scripts.text: Universe
scripts.translation: 宇宙

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, that's right, 'Earth.' Alvis was able to also answer Thor's question correctly.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
沒錯，就是“地”。阿爾維斯也正確回答了托爾的問題。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Thor then gave Alvis another question. What is the giant's term for the round shell that covers the earth?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
接著，托爾又問了他一個問題。在巨人的語言中，覆蓋大地的圓形外殼叫什麼？

scripts.text: Ymir's Head
scripts.translation: 尤彌爾的頭

scripts.text: Sky
scripts.translation: 天空

scripts.text: Cloud Factory
scripts.translation: 雲工廠

scripts.text: High House
scripts.translation: 高屋

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
That's it, 'High House.' Since the giants are so huge, it might have looked that way to them.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
沒錯，是“高屋”。因為巨人非常巨大，所以在他們看來可能就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
So Thor gave him another question. What is the term for the ball that rises in the sky at night, as used by the gods?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
於是托爾又問了他一個問題。在眾神的語言中，夜晚升上天空的球體叫什麼？

scripts.text: Circling Wheel
scripts.translation: 旋轉之輪

scripts.text: Moon
scripts.translation: 月亮

scripts.text: False Sun
scripts.translation: 假太陽

scripts.text: Fast Stranger
scripts.translation: 飛馳的過客

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes! Gods refer to the
moon as the 'false sun.'
Although Alvis answered all of Thor's questions, he didn't notice the sun was rising.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
沒錯！眾神稱月亮為“假太陽”。
雖然阿爾維斯回答了托爾的所有問題，但他沒有注意到太陽正在升起。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes...
Thor prolonged his test so that Alvis would be turned to stone
once the sun rose.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
是的...
托爾故意拖延測試，以便在太陽昇起時將阿爾維斯變成石頭。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There are two
things we can learn
from this story. First, do not covet something to the point of challenging fate or the gods.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
從這個故事中我們可以學到兩件事。第一，不要貪得無厭，甚至去挑戰命運或眾神。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Secondly, do not have too much pride in yourself. No matter how much ability or talent you may have, you cannot get everything
you want.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
第二，不要過於自負。無論你的能力或天賦有多高，你都無法得到你想要的一切。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
It's most
important to live a
good and virtuous life. It's great to achieve your desires, but be aware that some desires are not meant to be fulfilled.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
最重要的是過一種善良而正直的生活。實現願望固然很好，但要知道有些願望是不該被滿足的。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Thank you for listening to my long story. If you meet anyone afflicted with an insatiable desire, please tell him this story of Thor and Alvis, a brave yet very defiant Dwarf.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
謝謝你聽我講這麼長的故事。如果你遇到任何被無盡慾望困擾的人，請告訴他托爾和阿爾維斯的故事，這位勇敢但非常傲慢的矮人。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh...?
I don't think that's right. Let me think, maybe I can remember it. Hopefully, it'll come to me sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
嗯...？
我覺得不對。讓我想想，也許我能想起來。希望我遲早能想起來...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Shall we talk more of this once again after enjoying another Red Potion? Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
我們再喝一杯紅色藥水，然後繼續聊這個話題吧？哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Oooh...
I'm sooo thirsty!
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
哦哦...
我渴死了！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Hm, didn't I ask you to bring a Red Potion? There's no way I can tell any stories with such a dry throat~
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
嗯，我不是讓你帶紅色藥水來嗎？嗓子這麼幹，我沒法講故事啊~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
你找我有什麼事，人類？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
You're funny, leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
你真有趣，別煩我了。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Odd. Recently, too many humans have been interested in meeting with me and my brothers. Still, I cannot say their visits have been unpleasant.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
奇怪。最近有太多人類想見我和我的兄弟們了。不過，我也不能說他們的來訪不愉快。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
I'm a little thirsty. Would you bring me a Red Potion. If you do that for me, I will tell you an important story. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
我有點渴。你能給我帶一瓶紅色藥水嗎？如果你幫我這個忙，我會告訴你一個重要的故事。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Zzzz Zzzz Zzzz...

[Nordri]
I am Nordri,
Dwarven Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
我是諾德里，矮人鐵匠。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
I am in charge of this Northern part of Mount Mjolnir. If you wish to pass, you must first secure my approval!
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
我負責雷神之錘山北部的守衛工作。如果你想通過，必須先得到我的批准！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Ho ho ho...
Calm down, it
was only a joke.
Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[諾德里]
呵呵呵...
冷靜點，我只是開個玩笑。
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Zzzz Zzzz Zzzz...
